steps.content: Dodge! ...Jump over! ...You can do it! ...Take back the painting! ...Take it back!
Sitting by the counter, Kisugi Hitomi stares at her hands.
The leap she made in the gallery a few days ago appears to be a flawless escape from a tight spot. Yet she knows, with absolute certainty, that the distance was impossible for her alone.
That surge of power, that sudden heightening of her agility in a crisis... what is it?
And the sensation of her heart plummeting...
(Chief's portrait)

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Sinners... the power of Mania...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: And that person... the "Chief" who oversees all the Sinners.
From the moment they arrived, the keywords Kisugi Ai pulled from the news have stayed with them.
She recalls the principle: this force can tap into a person's dormant potential, bestowing capabilities they never had. Given that, the fact she shattered her own limits must mean...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Is everything alright, Hitomi?
Rui's voice pulls Hitomi out of her thoughts. Catching her sister's worried look, Hitomi brushes it off with a wave.
Kisugi Rui's eyes drift to the collection room, and she considers for a moment.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: You're right to be wary, Hitomi. But with no other leads at the moment, we follow this trail for now.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Though... I've been wondering about it myself.
Kisugi Rui takes a seat next to her sister, giving her arm a comforting pat.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: I can feel it too. A kind of... stirring within me. A new power.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: It's a power Ai and I don't easily notice, but Hitomi—you're the most agile among us, and your instincts have always been the sharpest.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: I'm sure you can feel it, right?
Kisugi Hitomi's smile is her admission. Her older sister sees right through her, so she simply nods.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: I should've known, Rui—you see through everything. You even saw what I've been worrying about.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: This power... it flares up whenever we're near that person—the Chief. Almost as if the Chief's influencing us somehow...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Perhaps this world is governed by this power, and by that person. That's why I've been thinking... Simply gathering the pieces of the Otherland Angels might not... be enough.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: It's true. We still know so little about him, and about this world. But...
steps.female_content: It's true. We still know so little about her, and about this world. But...

steps.content: Kisugi Rui walks to the counter, brews a cup of coffee, and slides it over to Kisugi Hitomi.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: They know just as little about us. Let's use that to gather intel and retrieve all the paintings.
Warm, fragrant steam rises from the coffee, softening the air and soothing their nerves.
In the quiet of their whispered planning, the door chime suddenly cuts through. A customer has arrived.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Welcome—Eh?
Hi there! Sorry to drop in!
In the doorway stands a familiar girl in uniform. And just behind her, peeking out, is the café's youngest sister, Kisugi Ai.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hehe! Rui, Hitomi, look who I found!
With cheerful greetings to the sisters, Kisugi Ai and the girl step aside, swinging the door wide for the people behind them.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Oh, come on, don't just stand there!
Wynn seizes Eugene, pulls him inside to stand behind her, and waves to the person trailing behind.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief, come on in!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I was hoping for another cup. Been thinking about it these days.
You scratch your cheek, sheepish, and accept Wynn and Kisugi Ai's invitation inside.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: My, my. When we said we looked forward to meeting again, I didn't expect it to be quite this soon.
With quiet composure, Kisugi Hitomi stands up and hands you the paper menu.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: The same as last time? I take it you're all in the area on business again?
You accept the menu, skim through the options, and tap your finger at the oat latte.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Something like that, though it's not as urgent as last time.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The leads we spent all night chasing ran cold around here, so I thought I'd come back today to see if I could find anything.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your sister spotted us and kindly extended an invitation.

Freshly aproned, Kisugi Ai approaches the counter. She catches the words, props her chin thoughtfully in her hand, and leans forward with a knowing, cheeky grin, her gaze settling on all three of you.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Sure did! It felt like fate, so I dragged everyone over for a break!
Kisugi Ai winks at her two older sisters, her smug expression practically shouting, I nailed it, right?
Both older sisters pick up on her little scheme at once. Behind your back, Kisugi Hitomi returns a quiet thumbs-up.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm glad she did. The coffee here is amazing. Smells wonderful and tastes even better, so I'd love another cup.
You pass the menu to Eugene and Wynn, adding casually.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Besides, keeping coffee this good safe is practically part of the job.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Oh? Sounds like things are a little complicated this time?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Ai, some things are better not to ask.
Kisugi Hitomi, at Ai's side, tousles her little sister's hair before turning an apologetic glance your way.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: It's alright. Actually, I was about to bring it up with you anyway.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Huh? With... us?
The three sisters exchanged startled glances, their heads tilting in quiet bewilderment.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Otherland Angels. You've heard of that painting, right?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: It's quite the sensation lately. With all the news and ads, it'd be hard not to know.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then you've probably also heard that the so-called "Marauders" have it in their sights.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They've pulled off several heists already, each time slipping through tight security. Just recently, they made off with an original piece.
You take the coffee, drink from it, and look over the rim at the sisters across from you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: To be honest, if that were all, it wouldn't necessarily be our concern.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The problem is...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: These thieves might be dangerous Sinners. The kind who who wouldn't hesitate to take a life.
Kisugi Hitomi's face grows serious, her demeanor shifting abruptly. Masking the change, she slides a plate of freshly baked cookies onto the table between you and Wynn.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: That's... terrible. But aren't Sinners... fairly common these days?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They are. But a Sinner's abilities are tied closely to their state of mind. If that mind isn't stable, their power can easily resonate with a Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: You mean...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If these vicious thieves continue unchecked, their actions could very well plunge this city into darkness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Besides, there have been several minor Black Rings near Eastside acting up recently. It has me concerned.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So for now, please be careful when you're out. And since your café sees a lot of people, let me know immediately if you notice anything unusual.
Reaching into your coat pocket, you pull out a piece of paper the size of a flyer and hand it over to the sisters.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is the local Public Security Bureau's hotline. It'd be good to scan the QR code here, too...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't worry, it's nothing invasive. It's a precaution. Helps prevent scams, and can reach us even without a signal in an emergency.
The three sisters nod.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: You have our word. We'll certainly be cautious...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: With a guardian like you watching over the city, we believe it will remain safe from the darkness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Guardian, huh... The work never really ends. Thank you for the excellent coffee. Let's go, Wynn, Eugene.
Wynn downs the last of her drink in a quick sip and nudges Eugene.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Huh? ...Oh, and best of luck with your business.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Between monitoring Black Ring activity and setting up the new exhibition at the <color=#fb9259>Central Gallery</color> to draw out those criminals... I'm afraid we really must be going. Apologies for the haste.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: You're too kind. We're honored.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Take care, Wynn. Do your best.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Huh? Oh, yes! I'll do everything I can to help Chief and Eugene!
As you guide your team to the exit, you continue chatting calmly with Wynn and Eugene, your tone steady and reassuring.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Try not to worry. We'll have additional support guarding the exhibition this time.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: After all, even they are keen to meet the phantom thief group known as "Cat's Eye" in person.
